Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in Step 2 by incorrectly inferring that the game was the 2013 reboot based solely on the fact that Alice David is the voice actress. While Alice David did voice Lara Croft in the 2013 game, she also voiced the character in the 2015 sequel (*Rise of the Tomb Raider*) and the 2019 entry (*Shadow of the Tomb Raider*), all developed by Crystal Dynamics. The Planner prematurely narrowed the scope to "Tomb Raider (2013)" without verifying if the specific game title was requested or if the developer remained consistent across her other roles. This led to a series of redundant verification steps (Steps 3-10) where the Planner repeatedly asked WebSurfer to confirm the developer of the 2013 game, despite the initial search already establishing that Alice David voices Lara Croft in the *Tomb Raider* series developed by Crystal Dynamics. The error was a failure to synthesize the broader context (that the developer is consistently Crystal Dynamics regardless of the specific year) and an unnecessary loop of verification for a detail that was already implicitly correct.
